semiconductor_relevance: None — TriQuanta Labs focuses on quantum computing, which is not directly part of the traditional semiconductor supply chain.
summary: TriQuanta Labs specializes in hybrid quantum computing, integrating neutral atoms and trapped ions to develop advanced quantum computers. Their platform supports 1024 qubits and features high gate fidelity, making significant advancements in quantum hardware.
capabilities: Hybrid quantum computing platform with 1024 qubits
High-fidelity entangling gate between neutral atom and trapped ion qubits
